exposure: Women with initial i-AVM rupture during pregnancy
Women diagnosed with i-AVM at conception
residual i-AVM with indication of treatment
outcome: Neurosurgery with the fetus in utero
finding: While most cases with residual i-AVM lesion and neurological symptoms could deliver vaginally without worsening of symptoms, pregnancy with i-AVM can be complicated by rupture of i-AVM, requiring meticulous care during pregnancy and after delivery.
mod_finding: Of the women diagnosed with i-AVM at conception, two delivered vaginally, 15 with residual i-AVM lesion or neurological symptoms succeeded in epidural birth, and one was delivered by cesarean section due to residual i-AVM requiring treatment.
